bio.text: Doug Lloyd is the Republican candidate for Michigan Attorney General in 2026, nominated at the party convention on August 22.

According to his campaign website, he has been Eaton County Prosecuting Attorney since 2013 and earlier served in the Eaton County Prosecutor's Office as an assistant prosecutor and chief assistant prosecutor.
His campaign website also says he is a past president of the Prosecuting Attorneys Association of Michigan and lives in Delta Township.
